narrative.intro: OptumServe Health Services has $1.9B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date across 12 awards. OptumServe Health Services' average award size is $156M, and obligations fell 26.4% year over year. OptumServe Health Services received the bulk of its FY2026 obligations from the Department of Veterans Affairs, which obligated $1.8B. OptumServe Health Services also did work for the Department of Health and Human Services and the Department of Defense, which obligated $11.5M and $11M respectively. OptumServe Health Services' FY-by-FY obligations show multi-year variation: FY21 was $756M, FY22 was $874M, FY23 was $711M, FY24 was $1.6B, FY25 was $2.5B, and FY26 is $1.9B. OptumServe Health Services' federal work centers on physician and outpatient services. OptumServe Health Services recorded $1.8B in Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists), $11M in Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists, $10.8M in All Other Outpatient Care Centers, and $719K in All Other Miscellaneous Ambulatory Health Care Services.

sections.heading: How concentrated are OptumServe's federal obligations by agency?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs is the dominant buyer, obligating $1.8B in FY2026 to date. The Department of Health and Human Services and the Department of Defense are much smaller buyers, obligating $11.5M and $11M respectively. Overall, OptumServe Health Services totaled $1.9B in FY2026 obligations across 12 awards, which gives the VA clear concentration of obligations.

sections.heading: Which healthcare markets dominate OptumServe's federal work?
sections.body: Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) is the largest market, with $1.8B in obligations. Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists and All Other Outpatient Care Centers are minor markets with $11M and $10.8M respectively, and All Other Miscellaneous Ambulatory Health Care Services accounts for $719K. OptumServe Health Services' market mix is therefore heavily weighted toward physician office services.
